metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for pytest-vcr HTTP recording/replay isolation. It differs semantically from peer candidates (requests_mock for mocking, pyfakefs for filesystem mocking, session termination for agent lifecycle) and existing skills (Spring Boot configuration migration, URL routing). No existing skill covers VCR-based cassette recording. Peer candidates address different test isolation methods but do not overlap with VCR's record-and-replay approach.
